title: Weapon Enchantment
body:
Syntax: weapon enchantment <weapon> <flaming|frost|life|sharp|vorpal|shocking>
        weapon enchantment <chakra steel weapon> <fire|water|wind|lightning|earth>
        examine <weapon>

Bukijutsu level 55, 60 Chakra, 20 Stamina, 10-second cooldown (before level-based scaling). Bind one property per carried or wielded weapon. Traditional effects on damaging weapon hits: Flaming has a 25% chance to burn, Frost 25% to throw the victim off balance, Shocking 20% to stun, Life restores the wielder for up to 10% of damage dealt, Sharp adds 10% damage (minimum +1), and Vorpal adds roughly 16.7% (minimum +1). Short combat messages appear only when an effect activates.

Elemental properties work on any genuinely Chakra Steel-forged weapon type and require a revealed chakra nature of the chosen element. A Bukijutsu wielder with that same nature gains +50% weapon damage and an additional elemental effect: Fire Burn (40%), Water Chakra Drain (40%), Wind Off Balance (40%), Lightning Paralyzed (30%), or Earth +25% further direct damage instead of status. The effect does not trigger for other classes or wielders lacking the matching nature. Samurai Sabre, while active with a sword, stacks multiplicatively, starting at +5% and rising to +25% through four automatic passive tiers at levels 85, 140, 195 and 250.

A weapon supports one bound property at a time. DISENCHANTMENT removes it without destroying the weapon or its gem inlay. The property lasts across transfers, saves and reboots until removed or the item breaks. EXAMINE displays the property and durability; weapon names do not acquire visible suffixes. See HELP ENCHANTMENTS and HELP SAMURAI SABRE.
